description: Routing decisions pinned across representative changes, including the diff shapes Phase 2's review hardening exercised: renames, binary-only changes, quoted paths, and deletions. No executable router preceded this CLI, so each case records the decision the Markdown rules call for rather than replaying a predecessor.

cases.name: a rename routes on the post-change path

diff --git a/src/security/old-name.ts b/src/security/new-name.ts
similarity index 92%
rename from src/security/old-name.ts
rename to src/security/new-name.ts
--- a/src/security/old-name.ts
+++ b/src/security/new-name.ts
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
-const value = 1;
+const html = DOMPurify.sanitize(input);
